package consumer

import (
	oxide "github.com/csbxd/oxide/oxide-go/runtime"
	f "oxide-type-api-conformance"
)

func construct(ctx *oxide.Context) {
	value := f.Default__Node(ctx)
	var shared f.Ref__Node = value.Ref()
	var mutable f.Mut__Node = value.Mut()
	shared = mutable.Ref()
	_ = shared.Addr()
	_ = mutable.Addr()
	mutable.Field__Id().Set(uint32(7))
	var id uint32 = shared.Field__Id().Get()
	_ = id
	value.Drop(ctx)
	var result f.Value__Outcome = f.Make(ctx)
	result.Drop(ctx)
	event := f.New__Event__Empty(ctx)
	if event.Ref().Variant() != f.Variant__Event__Empty {
		panic("wrong empty event")
	}
	event.Drop(ctx)
}

func borrowedEvent(ctx *oxide.Context, event f.Value__Event) {
	text := f.DebugEvent(ctx, event.Ref())
	text.Drop(ctx)
}
